about_the_game:
Have you wondered what brought you here?
...
Why do you still fight back?

...
Don't let your guard down. Not for a second.

You've just moved away from your hometown into a wooden cabin some distant family member used to own. You were hoping to start on a new path in life. Already exhausted after moving in, you go to bed early.

When you wake up, something's terribly wrong. It's still night. The sky is bleeding strange colors. And you're not alone.

DIAPAUSE Is a point-and-click, sit-and-survive style indie horror game inspired by digital, analog and alternative horror from the internet era. During the night, you'll have to fend off the vicious monsters, creatures and constructs that haunt the dreary cabin you were so unfortunate to inhabit, only armed with your wits and a faulty flashlight. Taking on a dark, haunting low-poly aesthetic along with immersive and spine-crawling sound design, be ready to stand your ground.

Hold them back. This is bigger than your own life. Don't get caught.

Once the morning sun rises, you won't find rest quite yet. Relive long-forgotten memories in a mysterious location from your past. Explore your mind and solve puzzles in a 2d pixel art style. Uncover what is truly happening within the cabin - and outside of it. Perhaps the information you find while exploring will even help you while trying to survive.

They will be angry. Stay resilient.

FEATURES:

  • A complete 6 stage campaign of unique "Sit-and-Survive" style gameplay - stuck in one place with limited movement and limited resources, use the few tools you have at your disposal to fend off the creatures attacking you.

  • 2d pixel art puzzle exploration sections before each stage of survival, giving you information that will slowly help you find out how to defend yourself against the monsters of the night.

  • A terrifying, character-focused, intriguing story that will slowly reveal itself to you as the game progresses.

  • For the most dedicated players, harder challenges, deeper puzzles, and various hidden secrets are waiting to be discovered.

I'm proud of you.

You're stronger than you think you are.





Don't let him trick you.

content_descriptors.notes: Game has violent scenes as well as light gore for horror purposes. Death is implied, and on occasion shown. Mental illnesses as well as suicide are mentioned and/or alluded to.

short_description: A vessel WILL be chosen. DIAPAUSE is a dark, haunting sit-and-survive style indie horror game with low-poly models and pixel graphics. Stuck within a cabin with only your wits and a spotty flashlight, defend your life during the night and wander the halls of your deteriorating mind during the day.
